turnos.t: Why can a café charge two euros twenty for a coffee whose beans and milk cost forty cents?
Because it adds value. Added value is the difference between the price customers pay and the cost of the bought-in inputs. Here, one euro eighty per cup.
Where does that value come from?
Branding, convenience, quality, design or service. Fast baristas in a comfortable place near your office. More added value means more money to pay staff and rent, and still make a profit.
